title: Residential Valuer
description:
Introduction:

About The Company

Acumentis is Australia's only independent ASX-listed property valuation and advisory firm. With 350+ team members across 45 locations, we combine national scale with local support and a strong focus on service, inclusion and professional development.

Description:

About The Role

As a Residential Valuer, you will be a key member of our team, collaborating with fellow Valuers and Directors to achieve Acumentis' business objectives and regional goals. Your responsibilities will include:

  • High-Quality Valuations: Deliver valuations of the highest quality, adhering to client and company guidelines, and meeting required service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Market Expertise: Maintain a deep understanding of sales trends and market conditions to inform valuation practices.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with clients, contributing to business development initiatives.
  • Strategic Collaboration: Report regularly to the Regional Director and work closely to achieve targeted outcomes.
This position is also open to an Associate Director or Director role for the right candidate.
